pro_description.value: When you create your domain you can select 3 creatures for every point spent in this node, those creatures are placed in a random location of your choosing. Creatures moved in this way are considered 'Lost'. Any 'Lost' creatures within your domain must make an Intelligence Saving Throw at the start of each of their turns against your Domain's DC. On a failed save, that creature is subjected to the confusion spell. Every point invested in this node also increases the DC for this ability by 1.
